facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year. The application for a specific program or university is made according to the respective announcement on the internet. Please refer to the application requirements and application documents in the corresponding announcement.

For the European and worldwide programs, there are separate application procedures. The announcement and selection for the worldwide programs occur before the selection for the European programs. If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, it is possible to apply for the European exchange within the framework of the Erasmus+ program without restrictions.

The announcements and selection for the worldwide and European exchange occur concurrently. The announcements are published at the end of October with the application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
